footnotes.text: k_c=4/sqrt(h/t_w), but shall not be taken less than 0.35 nor greater than 0.76 for calculation purposes.
F_L=0.7F_y for major-axis bending of compact and noncompact web built-up I-shaped members with S_xt/S_xc >= 0.7; F_L=F_y S_xt/S_xc >= 0.5F_y for those members with S_xt/S_xc < 0.7.
M_y is the moment at yielding of the extreme fiber; M_p is the plastic bending moment. (Not used by the selected partial rows.)
